plan.rationale: Frozen objective is peak_allocated_bytes for single-GPU fp32 ResNet-18 inference (offline, batch 32) under images_per_second >= 0.95x baseline and logits/exact-top1 fidelity. The torch collector already ran and coverage.json shows 124/124 kernels associated with 0 unassociated, 0 autograd ranges and 0 ambiguous forward sequences, so no overlap, graph-tracing or attribution gap justifies nsys or execution_timeline. observations.json marks communication not_applicable (single-device, distributed_backend null), so collective_calibration and per-collective telemetry dimensions are excluded, and device_telemetry's device-wide NVML readings in native windows cannot resolve allocator-internal peaks within one ~ms-scale forward. python_runtime perturbs execution and its inclusive/self times are not clean scores for the throughput constraint. The actionable lever is candidate evaluation, so candidate_diagnostics alone is selected to measure per candidate the objective (peak_allocated_bytes), the constraint (images_per_second), fidelity (logits_max_abs_error, exact_top1_match) and peak composition (parameter_resident_bytes, the fixed 46,758,048 B fp32 floor of 11,689,512 params, versus peak_transient_activation_bytes, the reducible activation scratch above the 19,267,584 B batch input that dominates the remaining 205,033,472 B peak after the accepted chunked-stem revision). Unavailable dimensions and the observed reasons for each are listed in unavailable_fields.
